interventions.label: Switch to Liquid Cooling
interventions.description: Closed-loop liquid cooling eliminates evaporative water loss. WUE is capped at ~0.2 L/kWh (a site already below that is unchanged) and PUE increases ~10% for pumps/chillers unless the site is already liquid-cooled.

interventions.label: Switch to Air Cooling (Dry)
interventions.description: Air-cooled systems use zero water for cooling (WUE ≈ 0) but increase energy consumption 15-30% unless the site is already air-cooled. Best for cold or moderate climates.

interventions.label: 100% Recycled / Reclaimed Water
interventions.description: Eliminates freshwater withdrawal for cooling. Reduces community water impact and aquifer stress to near zero. Requires treatment infrastructure.

interventions.label: Upgrade to Tier IV Diesel Generators
interventions.description: Tier IV generators reduce NOx by 93% and PM2.5 by 95% compared to Tier II. Significant health cost reduction for nearby communities.

interventions.label: Switch to Natural Gas Generators
interventions.description: Natural gas generators produce ~90% less NOx and ~92% less PM2.5 than Tier II diesel. Also reduces SO₂ by 99%. Lower carbon per kWh.

interventions.label: 90% Renewable Energy
interventions.description: Procure 90% of electricity from additional renewable sources beyond the grid mix (PPAs / RECs). Reduces Scope 2 carbon, CUE and the grid-attributable health burden proportionally (v4: applied through renewProcuredPct; the grid emission factor is left untouched).

interventions.label: Waste Heat Recovery (District Heating)
interventions.description: Capture 60% of waste heat for district heating or industrial use. Converts environmental cost into revenue. Reduces local UHI effect.

interventions.label: Extend Server Lifespan to 6 Years
interventions.description: Extending server life from ~4 to 6 years reduces embodied carbon by ~33% and cuts e-waste generation proportionally. Trade-off: older hardware is less energy-efficient.

interventions.label: High-Albedo Roofing & Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Cool roofs (albedo 0.6+) and vegetation buffers reduce surface temperature 5-15°C. Each 10% vegetation increase → ~0.5°C ambient cooling.

interventions.label: 90% Hardware Reuse Program
interventions.description: Microsoft-class circular economy program: 83-90% hardware reuse, 10-17% recycle, <5% landfill. Reduces e-waste and critical mineral demand.
